description: This file defines an interface IEventHubReceiver for receiving messages from Azure Event Hubs, and an internal class EventHubReceiverProxy that implements this interface as a proxy or decorator around PartitionReceiver, used within the Orleans.Streaming.EventHubs namespace.

classes.name: EventHubReceiverProxy
classes.description: An internal class acting as a proxy/decorator implementing IEventHubReceiver, wrapping around PartitionReceiver to handle Event Hub message receiving logic.

methods.name: ReceiveAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously receives a batch of EventData from the Event Hub partition.
